# Toto: documentation and asset metadata

> Toto is the official European red fox mascot of Spanish Total.js: identity, transparent artwork, reusable face icons and a bilingual static presentation.

Limited-use license for the Total.js community: apps, sites and services showing Toto must state they were built with Total.js and link to totaljs.com or totaljs.es; public access does not grant an open asset license. English is the default (README.md, LICENSE.md, docs/); Spanish is in README.es.md, LICENSE.es.md and docs/es/. Node.js 18+ runs the local checks without dependencies. Artwork and trademark metadata describe this repository, not external verification.

---

<div align="center">
<img src="assets/poses/webp/toto-signature.webp" width="260" alt="Toto, the smiling orange fox of Spanish Total.js.">

# Meet Toto. <img src="assets/brand/favicon.png" width="32" height="32" alt="">
### A little fox with a big JavaScript heart.
**The official mascot of Spanish Total.js.**

**European red fox (*Vulpes vulpes*) · Toto™ · Mark of Spanish Total.js · OEPM M4411785**

[Español](README.es.md) · [Website](https://totaljs-es.github.io/toto/) · [His story](docs/story.md) · [Identity guide](docs/identity.md) · [Poses](docs/poses.md) · [Favicons](docs/favicon.md) · [License](LICENSE.md)
</div>

Toto is a **European red fox** (*Vulpes vulpes*) and gives a face to the curiosity, care and pleasure of building things together with **Total.js**. He welcomes newcomers, keeps us company while we learn, and celebrates the small moments when a project starts to work.

> **For the Total.js community:** bring Toto into your apps and your content. Just show that it was built with Total.js, with a link to totaljs.com or totaljs.es. [See how →](#use-toto-in-your-totaljs-apps)

## His story

The idea took shape in the Spanish Total.js community in October 2026: what if our community had a companion of its own?

We wanted a friendly, recognizable character for our applications, documentation and presentations. An early idea drew on the oversized ears of a fennec fox. The character evolved into a European red fox, a connection between Spain, home of our community, and Slovakia, where Total.js began.

The large ears stayed. So did the curiosity. Orange fur, a cream chest, dark paws and a generous fluffy tail made him recognizable. **Toto** was a short, friendly name with a small echo of Total.js.

Today he is the **official mascot of Spanish Total.js**.

[Read the full story →](docs/story.md)

## A European red fox

Toto is a **European red fox**, *Vulpes vulpes*: the same fox that lives in the forests, pastures and fields of Spain and Slovakia. You can tell by the traits of his species.

| Field guide | Toto |
| --- | --- |
| Common name | European red fox |
| Scientific name | *Vulpes vulpes* |
| Family | Canids (*Canidae*) |
| Fur | Reddish orange, with a cream chest and muzzle |
| Ears | Large, pointed, with dark edges |
| Paws | Dark, like charcoal stockings |
| Tail | Big and fluffy, with a light tip |
| His land | Spain, where Spanish Total.js grows, and Slovakia, where Total.js was born |

## Personality

| Trait | How you notice it |
| --- | --- |
| Curious | He peeks at whatever we are still learning. |
| Approachable | He welcomes you and keeps you company without taking over. |
| Inventive | He enjoys finding a simple solution. |
| Cheerful | He celebrates the small wins of everyday work. |
| A bit mischievous | A wink, a cup of coffee and one more idea to try. |

His role in apps built with Total.js is to add warmth. Text, status and controls still communicate clearly on their own. A celebration pose appears only after an operation succeeds.

## His first collection

Each pose is a standalone image with a transparent background, in WebP (800 px, light, for the web) and original PNG. Stable IDs let you reuse them consistently in your apps.

| Pose | Preview | When to use it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Signature** · `signature` | <img src="assets/poses/webp/toto-signature.webp" width="130" alt="Toto smiling and winking."> | Presentations, identity and sign-offs. |
| **Welcome** · `welcome` | <img src="assets/poses/webp/toto-welcome.webp" width="130" alt="Toto waves with a raised paw."> | First visits, introductions and onboarding. |
| **Thinking** · `thinking` | <img src="assets/poses/webp/toto-thinking.webp" width="130" alt="Toto tilts his head and touches his cheek thoughtfully."> | Tips, help and questions. |
| **Coding** · `coding` | <img src="assets/poses/webp/toto-coding.webp" width="130" alt="Toto works on a dark laptop."> | Tutorials and work in progress. |
| **Celebrate** · `celebrate` | <img src="assets/poses/webp/toto-celebrate.webp" width="130" alt="Toto celebrates with raised paws and a smile."> | A completed task or a new release. |
| **Something went wrong** · `error` | <img src="assets/poses/webp/toto-error.webp" width="130" alt="Toto scratches his head with a gently puzzled expression."> | Error pages and missing routes, with a clear explanation and a way forward. |

All files, sizes and alt texts are in the [pose catalog](assets/poses/manifest.json) and the [pose guide](docs/poses.md).

## A presentation to meet him

Visit **[totaljs-es.github.io/toto/](https://totaljs-es.github.io/toto/)** for his visual presentation: his story, the European red fox field guide, a gallery on light and dark backgrounds and the terms of use. Also available [in Spanish](https://totaljs-es.github.io/toto/es/).

## Use Toto in your Total.js apps

Toto belongs to the Total.js community. You can bring him into the apps, websites and services you build with Total.js, and creators can use him to illustrate Total.js content: tutorials, articles, videos, courses and talks.

**One condition: show clearly that it was built with Total.js, with a link to [totaljs.com](https://www.totaljs.com) or [totaljs.es](https://www.totaljs.es).** Put the notice where users can see it: next to Toto, in the footer, on the about page or in the credits.

Use him straight from here, with nothing to download:

```html
<a href="https://www.totaljs.com/">
  <img src="https://totaljs-es.github.io/toto/assets/poses/webp/toto-welcome.webp"
       width="160" height="160"
       alt="Toto, mascot of Spanish Total.js">
</a>
<p>Built with <a href="https://www.totaljs.com/">Total.js</a></p>
```

More examples, with all poses and their recommended uses, in the [pose guide](docs/poses.md).

## Terms of use

**Limited-use license.** Toto is not an open-source or freely reusable collection.

- **Allowed:** displaying the official, unmodified images in apps, websites and services built with Total.js, and in content that illustrates Total.js, always with the "Built with Total.js" notice and a link to totaljs.com or totaljs.es.
- **Requires written permission:** using Toto as the mascot or brand of anything unrelated to Total.js, creating derivatives or new poses, selling products with him, or redistributing the collection as an asset pack.

[Read the full license →](LICENSE.md) · [Versión en español](LICENSE.es.md)

Public access to the repository does not grant an open license. GitHub's platform terms, including viewing and forking rights, remain applicable.

### Un pequeño zorro con un gran corazón JavaScript.

Toto es un **zorro rojo europeo** (*Vulpes vulpes*) y pone cara a una forma de hacer las cosas: sentir curiosidad, aprender juntos y disfrutar construyendo. Nos acompaña entre líneas de código, primeras versiones, preguntas difíciles y pequeños logros que merecen celebrarse.

Su casa es **Spanish Total.js**. Esta es su presentación, su guía de identidad y la colección de poses para las apps y los contenidos de la comunidad Total.js.

> **Para la comunidad Total.js:** lleva a Toto a tus apps y a tus contenidos. Solo tienes que indicar que está creado con Total.js, con un enlace a totaljs.es o a totaljs.com. [Cómo hacerlo →](#usa-a-toto-en-tus-apps-totaljs)

## Una historia que empieza con una pregunta

En octubre de 2026 nos hicimos una pregunta: **¿y si nuestra comunidad tuviera un compañero propio?**

Queríamos un personaje cercano y reconocible. Alguien que pudiera dar la bienvenida en una app, acompañar una explicación o celebrar una nueva versión con nosotros. El primer boceto miraba hacia un fénec, con sus grandes orejas. La idea terminó tomando la forma de un zorro rojo europeo.

Ese zorro nos recordaba dos lugares importantes para nuestra historia: España, donde crece Spanish Total.js, y Eslovaquia, donde nació Total.js. Sus orejas conservaron aquella curiosidad inicial. Su cola se hizo grande, su sonrisa apareció y encontramos un nombre que cabía en cualquier conversación: **Toto**, un guiño a Total.js.

Hoy Toto es la mascota oficial de **Spanish Total.js**.

[Leer la historia completa →](docs/es/historia.md)

## Un zorro rojo europeo

Toto es un **zorro rojo europeo**, *Vulpes vulpes*: el mismo zorro que vive en los bosques, dehesas y campos de España y Eslovaquia. Lo reconoces por los rasgos de su especie.

| Ficha | Toto |
| --- | --- |
| Nombre común | Zorro rojo europeo |
| Nombre científico | *Vulpes vulpes* |
| Familia | Cánidos (*Canidae*) |
| Pelaje | Naranja rojizo, con pecho y hocico color crema |
| Orejas | Grandes, puntiagudas y con el borde oscuro |
| Patas | Oscuras, como unas medias de carbón |
| Cola | Grande y esponjosa, con la punta clara |
| Su tierra | España, donde crece Spanish Total.js, y Eslovaquia, donde nació Total.js |

## Así es Toto

| Rasgo | Cómo se nota |
| --- | --- |
| Curioso | Se asoma a lo que todavía estamos aprendiendo. |
| Cercano | Da la bienvenida y acompaña sin ocupar todo el espacio. |
| Ingenioso | Disfruta encontrando una solución sencilla. |
| Alegre | Celebra las pequeñas victorias del trabajo diario. |
| Un poco travieso | Un guiño, una taza de café y otra idea por probar. |

En las apps creadas con Total.js, su papel es aportar cercanía. Los textos, estados y controles siguen siendo claros por sí mismos, y la pose de celebración aparece solo cuando la operación se ha completado.

<!-- Agent guidance: AGENTS.md -->

# Toto: guidance for coding agents

Toto is the official mascot of **Spanish Total.js**, a European red fox (*Vulpes vulpes*). This repository contains his identity, licensed artwork, pose catalog and bilingual static presentation. It is not a Total.js server or an npm library: `package.json` is private and provides local tools only.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md) is the English entry point; [README.es.md](README.es.md) is Spanish. Keep their previews, links and pose coverage consistent.
- Read [the identity guide](docs/identity.md) before changing artwork, [the pose guide](docs/poses.md) for app integration, and [the favicon guide](docs/favicon.md) for face icons and the reusable ZIP.
- [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md) grants the Total.js community limited use, not an open-source asset license: every app, site or service showing Toto must state that it was built with Total.js, with a link to totaljs.com or totaljs.es. Keep that condition and the permitted-use language intact; English prevails over [LICENSE.es.md](LICENSE.es.md). [Trademark data](assets/brand/trademark.json) is local metadata, not evidence of a fresh registry check; do not infer registration or legal status from the application number.
- [docs/ai.md](docs/ai.md) maps this kit; [llms.txt](llms.txt) and [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) are generated documentation for assistants.

## Repository map

| Area | Source and responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Presentation | `index.html` (English, default), `es/index.html` (Spanish), `404.html` |
| Documentation pages | The Markdown in `docs/`, `docs/es/` and the two licenses is the source; `tools/pages.cjs` generates `story/`, `identity/`, `poses/`, `favicon/`, `trademark/`, `license/` and their `es/` equivalents plus `sitemap.xml`. Never edit the generated HTML; edit the Markdown and run `npm run generate` |
| Discovery | `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, `manifest.webmanifest`, JSON-LD and `hreflang` in both pages, plus `llms.txt` for agents |
| Interaction and layout | `scripts/presentation.js`, `styles/presentation.css` |
| Artwork | `assets/poses/toto-*.png`, web exports in `assets/poses/webp/`, brand assets in `assets/brand/` |
| Pose definitions | `tools/catalog.cjs` writes `assets/poses/manifest.json` and `assets/poses/catalog.js`; edit definitions, then regenerate |
| Brand | `assets/brand/`: official face, favicons, Apple icon, favicon ZIP, social preview and trademark metadata |
| AI documentation | `tools/llms.cjs` lists the pages and generates both `llms` files; `tests/ai.test.cjs` checks kit integrity |

## Working conventions

- Use existing static HTML, CSS and plain JavaScript. No framework, build system or server is needed. Node.js 18+ runs all checks without installing packages; WebP generation (800 px and 480 px per pose) separately needs `cwebp` on PATH.
- Preserve the warm visual design, soft 3D illustration style, species and recognizable features. Additional poses should use the original portrait as reference. Keep the original artwork intact.
- The face-only artwork is `assets/brand/toto-face.png`. Use its favicon exports for small icons; update the reusable ZIP and its guide when its contents change.
- Keep Spanish and English pages equivalent. Relative paths in `es/index.html` start with `../` and it sets `data-root="../"`; English is the default and lives at the root. Documentation follows the same rule: English in `docs/`, Spanish in `docs/es/`, `README.md`/`LICENSE.md` in English and `README.es.md`/`LICENSE.es.md` in Spanish; pose paths in the manifest are relative to the repository root, and the browser script uses the page's `data-root` prefix.
- Keep the header sticky and the language switch accessible on mobile. Anchor navigation must clear the header. Check modified layouts on narrow screens and desktop; preserve keyboard focus, descriptive alt text and reduced-motion behavior.
- Poses accompany real text and state. Show `celebrate` after confirmed success; use `error` with an explanation and a recovery action. Images alone never indicate real progress or success.
- GitHub Pages serves this static tree under `/toto/`. Preserve `.nojekyll`, canonical/social metadata and absolute asset URLs in `404.html`, which must work from missing nested paths.
- Generated catalogs and `llms` files are checked in. Regenerate them from their sources; do not maintain a second copy by hand.

## Commands

```sh
npm run generate          # regenerate the pose catalogs, both llms files, the documentation pages and the sitemap
npm run check             # artwork, links, catalogs and AI-kit integrity
npm run check:ai          # AI-kit and generated documentation checks only
npm run check:pages       # documentation pages: freshness, links, hreflang, sitemap
npm test                  # same complete local checks as npm run check
node tools/webp.cjs       # regenerate WebP exports; requires cwebp
git diff --check
```

When presentation changes, also serve the repository with a local static server and verify the affected interactions in a real browser. Local checks do not prove a GitHub Pages deployment, external registry status or email-client rendering. Report the checks actually performed and distinguish local changes from published changes.

## Local workflows

Codex entry points are in `.agents/skills/`; each links to the maintained workflow in `.claude/skills/`. Their paths and commands are relative to the repository root. Select the relevant workflow: `toto-add-pose`, `toto-update-site` or `toto-verify-change`.

`CLAUDE.md` and `GEMINI.md` import this guide; `.github/copilot-instructions.md` provides a short pointer. Repository guidance does not grant filesystem, network or publishing permissions.

<!-- AI kit: docs/ai.md -->

# Working with Toto using AI assistants

This kit gives an arriving assistant the repository's actual structure, visual identity, asset contracts and verification commands. It follows the shared-workflow layout used by our other repositories, adapted to a small static mascot site.

## Entry points

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) | Maintained project instructions, source files and working conventions |
| [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md), [GEMINI.md](../GEMINI.md) | Imports of the common instructions |
| [Copilot instructions](../.github/copilot-instructions.md) | Short project-specific guidance pointing to AGENTS.md |
| [llms.txt](../llms.txt) | Linked index for models choosing which documents to read |
| [llms-full.txt](../llms-full.txt) | The same documentation and asset metadata in one file |
| [Pose manifest](../assets/poses/manifest.json) | Stable pose IDs, paths, dimensions, bilingual alt text and intended use |
| [Trademark metadata](../assets/brand/trademark.json) | Locally recorded brand data; not a live registry verification |

The original artwork and [identity guide](identity.md) define Toto. Machine-readable descriptions do not replace visual review. The [license](../LICENSE.md) remains proprietary with a limited permission to display official assets; the AI kit does not broaden that permission.

## Skills

The maintained workflow lives in `.claude/skills/`. Each matching `.agents/skills/` entry links to that same file rather than duplicating it.

| Workflow | Codex entry | Shared checklist |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Add or revise a pose | [toto-add-pose](../.agents/skills/toto-add-pose/SKILL.md) | [Artwork and catalog workflow](../.claude/skills/toto-add-pose/SKILL.md) |
| Maintain the presentation | [toto-update-site](../.agents/skills/toto-update-site/SKILL.md) | [Bilingual website and icons](../.claude/skills/toto-update-site/SKILL.md) |
| Verify a change | [toto-verify-change](../.agents/skills/toto-verify-change/SKILL.md) | [Local and browser verification](../.claude/skills/toto-verify-change/SKILL.md) |

Start the assistant in the Toto repository so its local guidance and skills can be discovered. If the chat uses another workspace, explicitly read this repository's `AGENTS.md` and the applicable workflow. Mentioning a path alone does not change a chat's working directory or permissions. These instructions do not grant filesystem, network or publication access. `.claude/settings.json` only configures Claude Code's named local commands; other assistants use their own environment permissions.

## Maintain and verify the kit

```sh
npm run generate
npm run check
```

The generator updates the pose catalogs plus both `llms` files. Edit pose definitions in `tools/catalog.cjs` and the documentation list in `tools/llms.cjs`; the generated outputs are checked in. Adding a document under `docs/` requires adding it to that list.

`npm run check` validates existing artwork, catalogs and page assets, then runs the kit integrity tests. `npm run check:ai` runs only the latter. All use Node.js 18+ without installing dependencies. `node tools/webp.cjs` additionally needs `cwebp`; it is only needed when changing the PNG/WebP collection. The generators do not create new artwork or rebuild the favicon ZIP.

The tests verify local document links and image paths, executable npm-script references, shared skill metadata/routing, allowed-command targets, documentation coverage and freshness of the generated files. They do not prove remote link availability, publication, browser behavior, email rendering, legal status or a particular assistant's decisions. Use real browser checks when changing the presentation.

<!-- His story: docs/story.md -->

# Toto, a little fox with a big JavaScript heart

**The story of the official mascot of Spanish Total.js.**

## A face for our community

A community is also recognized in its small gestures: an answer when someone gets stuck, a shared idea, an application that finally works. We wanted to give a face to that closeness.

The idea of Toto took shape in Spanish Total.js in October 2026. The goal was simple: to create a companion that could live in our applications, documentation and presentations. A character able to welcome someone who has just arrived and to keep company those who have been building with us for a long time.

## From big ears to a fox with a name of his own

The first starting point was the fennec fox and its enormous ears. We liked that look of attention: it seemed always about to discover something. Then a connection closer to our own story appeared: the European red fox (*Vulpes vulpes*), the fox that lives in Spain and in Slovakia.

Spain and Slovakia are part of the origin of this idea: Spanish Total.js grows here; Total.js was born there. The fox was the link we chose to represent that relationship. We kept the big ears, the orange fur, the light chest and a tail impossible to overlook.

The name came naturally. **Toto** was short, easy to remember and had a small echo of Total.js. It also sounded like someone you could call from across the table.

## What he represents

Toto is curious about projects that are just beginning. He likes questions, small experiments and the moment an idea finds its shape. He has the patience to accompany an explanation and a smile ready to celebrate that something went well.

His personality comes from what we want to look after in the Total.js community: sharing what we learn, keeping the joy of creating and making whoever arrives feel accompanied.

He has a mischievous side. Sometimes he gets distracted by another idea before finishing his coffee. That is also part of Toto: the enthusiasm of people who always have something new to try.

## His place in our applications

Toto can greet you when an app opens, accompany a help screen or appear when we finish a task. His presence has an intention: to add warmth at the right moments.

The messages, states and actions of each application remain clear by themselves. Toto adds expression and personality to that experience. In a delicate error or an urgent situation we prefer a direct explanation and a useful way out, with a discreet presence of the mascot.

## His home, today

Toto is the **official mascot of Spanish Total.js** and a mark of Spanish Total.js (**Toto™**, OEPM **M4411785**). The Total.js community can bring him into apps built with Total.js, as the [license](../LICENSE.md) describes.

[Trademark details](trademark.md).

---

## A short tale to introduce him

*A character tale: an imagined way to tell his personality.*

Toto arrived one evening when a light was still on in front of the computer. There was a half-built application, an unanswered question and a cup of coffee that had already gone cold.

He sat next to the screen, tilted his head and waited. When the first “Hello, world” finally appeared, he raised a paw as if he wanted to say hello too.

Since then he stays close. He accompanies the first tests, peeks at new ideas and celebrates every small victory. If something takes a while to come out, he sits down next to us again.

Toto loves that moment when someone says: “That's it. Now it works.”

**A little fox with a big JavaScript heart.**

<!-- Identity guide: docs/identity.md -->

# Toto's identity

Toto is the official mascot of **Spanish Total.js**. This guide helps create and review materials that show him. Other uses follow the [license](../LICENSE.md).

## Reference image

The [original portrait](../assets/poses/toto-signature.png) defines his main look: a softly shaded 3D illustration finish, rounded shapes, orange fur, an expressive gaze and a recognizable silhouette.

## A European red fox

Toto is a **European red fox** (*Vulpes vulpes*), not a fennec or a fantasy fox. When presenting him, always name the species and respect the traits that define it: reddish-orange fur, dark-edged ears, dark paws and a big tail with a light tip.

## Traits we keep

- Large, pointed ears with a dark edge and a light pink interior.
- A characteristic tuft over the forehead.
- Big amber and brown eyes, a small dark nose.
- Cream muzzle and chest.
- Charcoal-coloured paws.
- A big fluffy tail with a light tip.
- A kind, curious and slightly mischievous expression.

Every pose is reviewed to keep these traits; identity takes priority over accidental variations between images.

## Companion palette

These colours guide interfaces and communication pieces. The illustration keeps its natural lights, shadows and variations.

| Colour | Value | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Toto orange | `#FF751F` | Accents and calls to attention. |
| Cream | `#FFEAD4` | Warm backgrounds and details. |
| Charcoal | `#202B34` | Text and contrast. |
| Slate | `#536179` | Secondary information. |
| Paper | `#FFF9F2` | Light surfaces. |

## Size and space

- Keep the original aspect ratio and `object-fit: contain`.
- Leave room around ears, paws and tail. As a guide, 10 % outer margin.
- For favicons and small avatars, use the [official face icon](favicon.md), with its complete ears and without distorting it. The kit includes variants from 16 to 512 px.
- Check light and dark backgrounds before integrating a pose.
- Keep the transparency and soft edges of the original PNG.

## How he speaks

Toto speaks warmly, in simple sentences. He can greet, accompany a suggestion or celebrate an achievement. Messages avoid jokes at the user's expense and explain actions precisely.

Examples:

- “Hi, I'm Toto. Let's set up your first job.”
- “I have a hint: check the measurements before continuing.”
- “Done! Your work is saved.”

In a product, a celebration pose appears after the operation has really completed. A working pose comes with a textual status; the image alone does not indicate progress or guarantee a result.

## Trademark

Presentation and attribution use **Spanish Total.js**. The character's name is **Toto**, a mark of Spanish Total.js (**Toto™**, OEPM **M4411785**). See the [trademark details](trademark.md).

## Uses that require authorization

Changing his anatomy, colours, clothing or accessories; creating new poses; animating him; turning him into another mascot; building him into a third-party identity or making merchandise. Technical exports without visual changes, such as reducing the size, follow the permission in the [license](../LICENSE.md).

<!-- Pose integration: docs/poses.md -->

# Toto's poses in your apps

Toto belongs to Spanish Total.js. The Total.js community may bring him into apps built with Total.js, and creators may use him to illustrate Total.js, under the [license](../LICENSE.md). The one condition: **show clearly that your app, website or service was built with Total.js, with a link to totaljs.com or totaljs.es.**

**Toto™** is a mark of Spanish Total.js · OEPM **M4411785**. [Trademark details](trademark.md).

## Catalog

The [JSON manifest](../assets/poses/manifest.json) contains the identifier, file, dimensions, alt texts and intent of each pose. Manifest paths are relative to the repository root. Every pose exists as **WebP** (800 px, light, for web) and as an original **PNG** (dimensions in the manifest), both with an alpha channel. Use the WebP unless you need the maximum resolution; some older email clients, such as desktop Outlook, do not display WebP: use the PNG there.

| Stable ID | Asset | Recommended use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `signature` | `assets/poses/webp/toto-signature.webp` · `assets/poses/toto-signature.png` | Identity, presentations and sign-offs. |
| `welcome` | `assets/poses/webp/toto-welcome.webp` · `assets/poses/toto-welcome.png` | Welcome, first steps and initial help. |
| `thinking` | `assets/poses/webp/toto-thinking.webp` · `assets/poses/toto-thinking.png` | Tips and open questions. |
| `coding` | `assets/poses/webp/toto-coding.webp` · `assets/poses/toto-coding.png` | Tutorials and operations in progress. |
| `celebrate` | `assets/poses/webp/toto-celebrate.webp` · `assets/poses/toto-celebrate.png` | Success confirmation and new releases. |
| `error` | `assets/poses/webp/toto-error.webp` · `assets/poses/toto-error.png` | Error pages and missing routes, with an explanation and a recovery action. |

The [gallery on the website](https://totaljs-es.github.io/toto/#poses) lets you switch the background and see how each pose looks.

## HTML

You can link the image straight from Toto's website, with nothing to download. Put it where users can see it, for example in the footer or the about page of your app, with the Total.js notice and link:

```html
<a href="https://www.totaljs.com/">
  <img src="https://totaljs-es.github.io/toto/assets/poses/webp/toto-welcome.webp"
       width="160" height="160"
       alt="Toto, mascot of Spanish Total.js">
</a>
<p>Built with <a href="https://www.totaljs.com/">Total.js</a></p>
```

```css
.toto {
  display: block;
  width: min(160px, 100%);
  height: auto;
  object-fit: contain;
}
```

## Total.js

In an app built with Total.js, link the pose from the view:

```html
<img src="https://totaljs-es.github.io/toto/assets/poses/webp/toto-thinking.webp" width="128" height="128"
     alt="Toto is thinking.">
<p>Check the data before continuing.</p>
<footer>Built with <a href="https://www.totaljs.com/">Total.js</a></footer>
```

For a decorative image that accompanies equivalent text, use `alt=""`. If it conveys something not written elsewhere, describe that meaning. The file name alone is not useful alternative text.

## Practical rules

- Use the pose as a companion to an understandable interface.
- Respect the proportion, the silhouette and the margin around the image.
- Do not let Toto cover actions, errors, data or navigation.
- Choose a background with enough contrast and check dark mode too.
- Accompany a task in progress with a real textual status; the `coding` pose is static.
- Show `celebrate` when the application has confirmed success.
- Show `error` with a clear explanation and a way forward.
- Keep a respectful tone when the user runs into an error.

## Check the collection

With Node.js available, run from the root:

```sh
npm run check
```

The check validates asset paths, PNG and WebP dimensions, the alpha channel, unique identifiers and the match between the gallery catalogs. It installs no packages and uses no external services.

[Versión en español](es/poses.md)

# Toto's face on our websites

Official face icon: it keeps Toto's wink and smile, with both ears complete and no body or tail. The favicons have transparent backgrounds; the Apple icon uses a Paper (#FFF9F2) background and extra margin. Their use follows [Toto's license](../LICENSE.md).

## Files

- [Kit to copy to another website](../assets/brand/toto-favicons.zip): icons, original, this guide and license.
- [Original face PNG](../assets/brand/toto-face.png): master image with transparency.
- [favicon.ico](../assets/brand/favicon.ico): includes 16, 32 and 48 px.
- PNG: [16](../assets/brand/favicon-16.png), [32](../assets/brand/favicon-32.png), [48](../assets/brand/favicon-48.png), [64](../assets/brand/favicon.png), [192](../assets/brand/favicon-192.png) and [512](../assets/brand/favicon-512.png) px.
- [apple-touch-icon.png](../assets/brand/apple-touch-icon.png): 180 × 180 px.

## Integration

Copy the icons to `assets/brand/` on the website and add these tags to its head. Adjust the paths if the application lives under a subdirectory. Toto's English, Spanish and 404 pages already include them.

```html
<link rel="icon" href="/assets/brand/favicon.ico" sizes="16x16 32x32 48x48">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" href="/assets/brand/favicon-32.png">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="16x16" href="/assets/brand/favicon-16.png">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" sizes="180x180" href="/assets/brand/apple-touch-icon.png">
```

As with any use of Toto, a site that shows him must state that it was built with Total.js, with a link to totaljs.com or totaljs.es. See the [license](../LICENSE.md).

<!-- Su historia: docs/es/historia.md -->

# Toto, un pequeño zorro con un gran corazón JavaScript

**La historia de la mascota oficial de Spanish Total.js.**

## Una cara para nuestra comunidad

Una comunidad también se reconoce en sus pequeños gestos: una respuesta cuando alguien se atasca, una idea compartida, una aplicación que por fin funciona. Queríamos darle una cara a esa cercanía.

La idea de Toto tomó forma en Spanish Total.js en octubre de 2026. El objetivo era sencillo: crear un compañero que pudiera vivir en nuestras aplicaciones, documentación y presentaciones. Un personaje capaz de recibir a alguien que acaba de llegar y de acompañar a quienes llevan tiempo construyendo con nosotros.

## De unas grandes orejas a un zorro con nombre propio

El primer punto de partida fue el fénec y sus enormes orejas. Nos gustaba aquella expresión de atención: parecía que siempre estaba a punto de descubrir algo. Después apareció una conexión más cercana a nuestra propia historia: el zorro rojo europeo (*Vulpes vulpes*), el zorro que vive en España y en Eslovaquia.

España y Eslovaquia forman parte del origen de esta idea: aquí crece Spanish Total.js; allí nació Total.js. El zorro fue el vínculo que elegimos para representar esa relación. Conservamos las grandes orejas, el pelaje naranja, el pecho claro y una cola imposible de pasar por alto.

El nombre llegó con naturalidad. **Toto** era corto, fácil de recordar y tenía un pequeño eco de Total.js. También sonaba a alguien a quien podías llamar desde el otro lado de la mesa.

## Lo que representa

Toto siente curiosidad por los proyectos que empiezan. Le gustan las preguntas, los pequeños experimentos y el momento en que una idea encuentra su forma. Tiene paciencia para acompañar una explicación y una sonrisa preparada para celebrar que algo ha salido bien.

Su personalidad nace de lo que queremos cuidar en la comunidad Total.js: compartir lo aprendido, mantener el gusto por crear y hacer que quien llega se sienta acompañado.

Tiene un punto travieso. A veces se distrae con otra idea antes de terminar el café. Eso también forma parte de Toto: el entusiasmo de quienes siempre tienen algo nuevo que probar.

## Su sitio en nuestras aplicaciones

Toto puede saludar al abrir una app, acompañar una ayuda o aparecer cuando terminamos una tarea. Su presencia tiene una intención: añadir cercanía en los momentos adecuados.

Los mensajes, estados y acciones de cada aplicación siguen siendo claros por sí mismos. Toto aporta expresión y personalidad a esa experiencia. En un error delicado o una situación urgente preferimos una explicación directa y una salida útil, con una presencia discreta de la mascota.

## Su casa, hoy

Toto es la **mascota oficial de Spanish Total.js** y una marca de Spanish Total.js (**Toto™**, OEPM **M4411785**). La comunidad Total.js puede llevarlo a apps creadas con Total.js, como describe la [licencia](../../LICENSE.es.md).

[Datos de la marca](marca.md).

---

## Un pequeño cuento para presentarlo

*Este es un relato de personaje, una forma imaginada de contar su personalidad.*

Toto llegó una tarde en la que todavía quedaba una luz encendida frente al ordenador. Había una aplicación a medio hacer, una pregunta sin resolver y una taza de café que ya se había enfriado.

Se sentó junto a la pantalla, ladeó la cabeza y esperó. Cuando por fin apareció el primer «Hola, mundo», levantó una pata como si él también quisiera saludar.

Desde entonces se queda cerca. Acompaña las primeras pruebas, se asoma a las ideas nuevas y celebra cada pequeña victoria. Si algo tarda en salir, vuelve a sentarse a nuestro lado.

A Toto le gusta ese momento en que alguien dice: «Ya está. Ahora funciona».

**Un pequeño zorro con un gran corazón JavaScript.**

[English version](../story.md)

<!-- Guía de identidad: docs/es/identidad.md -->

# La identidad de Toto

Toto es la mascota oficial de **Spanish Total.js**. Esta guía ayuda a crear y revisar piezas en las que aparece. Los demás usos se rigen por la [licencia](../../LICENSE.es.md).

## Imagen de referencia

El [retrato original](../../assets/poses/toto-signature.png) define el aspecto principal: ilustración de acabado suave en 3D, formas redondeadas, pelaje naranja, mirada expresiva y una silueta reconocible.

## Un zorro rojo europeo

Toto es un **zorro rojo europeo** (*Vulpes vulpes*), no un fénec ni un zorro de fantasía. Al presentarlo, nombra siempre la especie y respeta los rasgos que la definen: pelaje naranja rojizo, orejas con el borde oscuro, patas oscuras y cola grande con la punta clara.

## Rasgos que conservamos

- Orejas grandes y puntiagudas, borde oscuro e interior rosado claro.
- Un mechón característico sobre la frente.
- Ojos grandes de tonos ámbar y marrón, nariz pequeña y oscura.
- Hocico y pecho color crema.
- Patas de color carbón.
- Una cola grande y esponjosa con la punta clara.
- Expresión amable, curiosa y un poco traviesa.

Cada pose se revisa para mantener estos rasgos; la identidad tiene prioridad sobre variaciones accidentales entre imágenes.

## Paleta de acompañamiento

Estos colores orientan las interfaces y las piezas de comunicación. La ilustración mantiene sus luces, sombras y variaciones naturales.

| Color | Valor | Uso |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Naranja Toto | `#FF751F` | Acentos y llamadas de atención. |
| Crema | `#FFEAD4` | Fondos cálidos y detalles. |
| Carbón | `#202B34` | Texto y contraste. |
| Pizarra | `#536179` | Información secundaria. |
| Papel | `#FFF9F2` | Superficies claras. |

## Tamaño y espacio

- Mantén la relación de aspecto original y `object-fit: contain`.
- Deja aire alrededor de orejas, patas y cola. Como orientación, un 10 % de margen exterior.
- Para favicons y avatares pequeños, usa la [carita oficial de Toto](favicon.md), con sus orejas completas y sin deformarla. El kit incluye variantes de 16 a 512 px.
- Comprueba los fondos claro y oscuro antes de integrar una pose.
- Conserva la transparencia y los bordes suaves del PNG original.

## Cómo habla

Toto habla con cercanía y frases sencillas. Puede saludar, acompañar una sugerencia o celebrar un logro. Los mensajes evitan bromas a costa del usuario y explican las acciones con precisión.

Ejemplos:

- «Hola, soy Toto. Vamos a preparar tu primer trabajo».
- «Tengo una pista: revisa las medidas antes de continuar».
- «¡Listo! Tu trabajo está guardado».

En el producto, una pose de celebración aparece después de que la operación se haya completado de verdad. Una pose de trabajo va acompañada de un estado textual; la imagen por sí sola no indica progreso ni garantiza un resultado.

## Marca

La presentación y la atribución usan **Spanish Total.js**. El nombre del personaje es **Toto**, marca de Spanish Total.js (**Toto™**, OEPM **M4411785**). Consulta [los datos de la marca](marca.md).

## Usos que requieren autorización

Cambiar la anatomía, los colores del personaje, su ropa o accesorios; crear poses nuevas; animarlo; convertirlo en otra mascota; integrarlo en una identidad de terceros o fabricar mercancía. Las exportaciones técnicas sin cambios visuales —por ejemplo, reducir el tamaño— se rigen por el permiso de la [licencia](../../LICENSE.es.md).

[English version](../identity.md)

<!-- Poses: docs/es/poses.md -->

# Poses de Toto en tus apps

Toto pertenece a Spanish Total.js. La comunidad Total.js puede llevarlo a apps creadas con Total.js, y los creadores pueden usarlo para ilustrar Total.js, según la [licencia](../../LICENSE.es.md). La única condición: **indica con claridad que tu app, web o servicio está creado con Total.js, con un enlace a totaljs.com o a totaljs.es.**

**Toto™** es una marca de Spanish Total.js · OEPM **M4411785**. [Datos de la marca](marca.md).

## Catálogo

El [manifiesto JSON](../../assets/poses/manifest.json) contiene identificador, archivo, dimensiones, textos alternativos e intención de cada pose. Las rutas del manifiesto son relativas a la raíz del repositorio. Cada pose existe en **WebP** (800 px, ligero, para web y firmas) y en **PNG** original (dimensiones en el manifiesto) con canal alfa. Usa el WebP salvo que necesites la máxima resolución; algunos clientes de correo antiguos, como Outlook de escritorio, no muestran WebP: en ese caso usa el PNG.

| ID estable | Recurso | Uso recomendado |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `signature` | `assets/poses/webp/toto-signature.webp` · `assets/poses/toto-signature.png` | Identidad, presentaciones y firma. |
| `welcome` | `assets/poses/webp/toto-welcome.webp` · `assets/poses/toto-welcome.png` | Bienvenida, primeros pasos y ayuda inicial. |
| `thinking` | `assets/poses/webp/toto-thinking.webp` · `assets/poses/toto-thinking.png` | Consejos y preguntas sin resolver. |
| `coding` | `assets/poses/webp/toto-coding.webp` · `assets/poses/toto-coding.png` | Tutoriales y operaciones en curso. |
| `celebrate` | `assets/poses/webp/toto-celebrate.webp` · `assets/poses/toto-celebrate.png` | Confirmación de éxito y nuevas versiones. |
| `error` | `assets/poses/webp/toto-error.webp` · `assets/poses/toto-error.png` | Páginas de error y rutas no encontradas, con una explicación y una acción de recuperación. |

La [galería de la web](https://totaljs-es.github.io/toto/es/#poses) permite cambiar el fondo y comprobar cómo se ve cada pose.

## HTML

Puedes enlazar la imagen directamente desde la web de Toto, sin descargarla. Colócala donde los usuarios puedan verla, por ejemplo en el pie o en la página «acerca de» de tu app, con el aviso y el enlace a Total.js:

```html
<a href="https://www.totaljs.es/">
  <img class="toto" src="https://totaljs-es.github.io/toto/assets/poses/webp/toto-welcome.webp"
       width="160" height="160"
       alt="Toto, mascota de Spanish Total.js">
</a>
<p>Creado con <a href="https://www.totaljs.es/">Total.js</a></p>
```

```css
.toto {
  display: block;
  width: min(160px, 100%);
  height: auto;
  object-fit: contain;
}
```

## Total.js

En una app creada con Total.js, enlaza la pose desde la vista:

```html
<img src="https://totaljs-es.github.io/toto/assets/poses/webp/toto-thinking.webp" width="128" height="128"
     alt="Toto está pensando.">
<p>Comprueba los datos antes de continuar.</p>
<footer>Creado con <a href="https://www.totaljs.es/">Total.js</a></footer>
```

Para una imagen decorativa que acompaña a un texto equivalente, usa `alt=""`. Si comunica algo que no está escrito en otro lugar, describe ese significado. El nombre del archivo por sí solo no es un texto alternativo útil.

## Reglas prácticas

- Usa la pose como acompañamiento de una interfaz comprensible.
- Respeta la proporción, la silueta y el margen alrededor de la imagen.
- Evita que Toto tape acciones, errores, datos o navegación.
- Elige un fondo con suficiente contraste y revisa también el modo oscuro.
- Acompaña una tarea en curso con un estado textual real; la pose `coding` es estática.
- Muestra `celebrate` cuando la aplicación haya confirmado el éxito.
- Muestra `error` con una explicación clara y una salida útil.
- Mantén el tono respetuoso cuando el usuario encuentre un error.

## Comprobar la colección

Con Node.js disponible, ejecuta desde la raíz:

```sh
npm run check
```

La comprobación valida las rutas de los recursos, dimensiones PNG, canal alfa, identificadores únicos y correspondencia de los catálogos de la galería. No instala paquetes ni utiliza servicios externos.

[English version](../poses.md)

<!-- Iconos web: docs/es/favicon.md -->

# La carita de Toto en nuestras webs

Icono oficial de rostro: conserva el guiño y la sonrisa de Toto, con las orejas completas y sin cuerpo ni cola. Los favicons tienen fondo transparente; el icono de Apple usa fondo Papel (#FFF9F2) y margen adicional. Su uso se rige por la [licencia de Toto](../../LICENSE.es.md).

## Archivos

- [Kit para copiar a otra web](../../assets/brand/toto-favicons.zip): iconos, original, esta guía y licencia.
- [Cara original PNG](../../assets/brand/toto-face.png): imagen maestra con transparencia.
- [favicon.ico](../../assets/brand/favicon.ico): incluye 16, 32 y 48 px.
- PNG: [16](../../assets/brand/favicon-16.png), [32](../../assets/brand/favicon-32.png), [48](../../assets/brand/favicon-48.png), [64](../../assets/brand/favicon.png), [192](../../assets/brand/favicon-192.png) y [512](../../assets/brand/favicon-512.png) px.
- [apple-touch-icon.png](../../assets/brand/apple-touch-icon.png): 180 × 180 px.

## Integración

Copia los iconos en assets/brand/ de la web y añade estas etiquetas en su head. Ajusta las rutas si la aplicación vive bajo un subdirectorio. Las páginas española, inglesa y 404 de Toto ya las incluyen.

```html
<link rel="icon" href="/assets/brand/favicon.ico" sizes="16x16 32x32 48x48">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" href="/assets/brand/favicon-32.png">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="16x16" href="/assets/brand/favicon-16.png">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" sizes="180x180" href="/assets/brand/apple-touch-icon.png">
```

Como con cualquier uso de Toto, una web que lo muestre debe indicar que está creada con Total.js, con un enlace a totaljs.com o a totaljs.es. Consulta la [licencia](../../LICENSE.es.md).

[English version](../favicon.md)

---
